faqs.question: How to register for events?
faqs.answer: To register for an event, go to the Events page from your dashboard, browse the available events, and click on the 'Register' button for the event you wish to attend.

faqs.question: How to check notices?
faqs.answer: All important announcements are posted on the Notices page. You can access it directly from the dashboard sidebar or the main navigation menu.

faqs.question: How to use the campus map?
faqs.answer: The Campus Map provides an interactive view of all buildings and facilities. You can search for specific locations and get directions within the campus.

faqs.question: How to contact administration?
faqs.answer: You can find contact details for various departments on the Contacts page. For urgent matters, visit the Administrative Office in Block A during working hours.

faqs.question: How to view my registrations?
faqs.answer: Your registered events can be viewed in the 'My Registrations' section of your dashboard. This tracks all events you have successfully signed up for.

faqs.question: What to do if login fails?
faqs.answer: If you cannot log in, ensure your Student ID and password are correct. If you've forgotten your password, contact the IT Support desk or use the password recovery option if available.

faqs.question: Where can I find my course material?
faqs.answer: Course materials are usually uploaded to the Departmental Portal. Check with your respective faculty for specific platform details.
